scope: 2025 ICPC Xian B F G I J K L
limitations: Small-case verification only; no online judge submissions or maximum-size runtime tests. K verifies the matching criterion and operation closure, not a production Dinic implementation.

B.method: all 3-color count vectors through length9 with 16 boundary choices versus recursive arrangements; random full interval monotonicity

F.method: priority events versus simultaneous integer-time simulation with all contacts processed together

G.method: all distinct voter permutations for random n<=6 arrays

I.method: path-XOR matrices from random trees, recovered ancestor depths and all original parent edges

J.method: all source/target pairs on small branching trees versus Dijkstra over owned-node subsets with buy/merge operations

K.method: all arrays a,b for n<=4 and full closure under every permutation-AND operation versus matching criterion

L.method: descending-size monotone pointer versus all stick subsets, including no-solution larger k followed by feasible smaller k
